name: Mount Kilimanjaro
intro: Kilimanjaro is the highest free-standing mountain in the world and a non-technical trek, but altitude is the challenge. Longer routes give a far higher summit success rate.
Our guides and porters are locally employed and paid fairly, and every trek can be paired with a safari in the Serengeti or Ngorongoro Crater.
bestTime: January to March and June to October.
metaTitle: Kilimanjaro Climbing Tours | Machame Route | Glad Of Africa
metaDescription: Climb Mount Kilimanjaro with responsible local guides. Machame and other routes, plus safari combinations from Arusha.
